correctness.rationale: The four-regular inactive subgraph undergoes deterministic leaf pruning, so percolation is equivalent to induced-forestness. The line-graph restriction is equivalent to a linear forest on cube edges. The 7-edge extremal case is Hamiltonian. Complete enumeration by independently formulated 12-vertex dynamics and 12-edge union-find methods agrees on all 4096 subsets; timing and orbit assertions independently reproduce.
